full_feedback_AA_vs_RR.decision: The independent prospective full-feedback ensemble did not reproduce a stable directional AA-versus-RR long-horizon loss difference. Alignment is not a monotone scalar risk score.

full_feedback_factorial.decision: Trait and allele assignment are strongly non-additive. Cells in which trait and allele bundles are spatially mismatched have higher average functional-loss risk than cells in which those two layers remain matched.

q_only_intervention.decision: Removing direct trait and allele contributions to the q-support signal does not remove the long-horizon relational effect. It exposes a robust AA advantage, so indirect allele-linked recruitment, interaction-dependent trait selection and demographic-density feedback are sufficient to transmit the spatial mismatch.

mechanistic_interpretation.immediate_transition: At fixed marginal means, cross-layer covariance changes spatial support variance exactly; this accounts for the immediate transition non-sufficiency and the 0.2543 next-q separation.
mechanistic_interpretation.matching_pathway: When high allele frequency and high-trait resident mass co-occur in patches where interaction state makes the high trait fit, allele-linked recruitment and interaction-dependent selection replenish high-trait mass more effectively.
mechanistic_interpretation.compensation_pathway: When the eco-genetic bundle is placed in weak-interaction patches, direct trait/allele feedback into q raises those weak patches and can compensate the recruitment disadvantage by equalizing local interaction support.
mechanistic_interpretation.pathway_competition: Long-term fate is the net result of matching-dependent recruitment versus feedback-mediated compensation, not a monotone function of one alignment or support-variance score.
mechanistic_interpretation.trait_allele_coherence: Breaking trait-allele concordance is especially costly because the allele-linked recruitment kernel and resident trait state no longer reinforce the same local phenotype distribution.

claim_ceiling: For the declared finite closure, relational effects are pathway-dependent and non-additive. Do not treat alignment, support variance or refugia as universal directional risk scores, and do not reinterpret the original locked +5 pp propagation result as a universally reproducible alignment-protection effect.
